hypothesis_candidates.baseline: All clean, prospectively timestamped broad-market forward candidates.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: Rank fresh event-attention acceleration only when positioning and execution-crowding evidence remain benign.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: H10 primary; H5 and H20 diagnostics.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, the unconditioned clean broad cohort, and the same-day core alternative.
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: A fresh information-demand shock may drift when it is not already crowded into positioning or execution.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Reject if there are fewer than 60 clean settled decisions across 20 tickers, PIT provenance or touch density fails, or net replacement value is non-positive.
hypothesis_candidates.axis_note: The cross-surface join is not a new source; the registered clean-forward settlement bar remains unmet.

hypothesis_candidates.treatment: Admit only price-stabilized drawdowns with positive capital flow and complete downside-option stress context.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: H10 primary; H5 and H20 diagnostics.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, complement decisions, and the same-day core alternative.
